title: Inadequate water pressure.
officialText:
Wherever water pressure from the street main or other source of supply is insufficient to provide
flow pressures at fixture outlets as required under Table 604.3, a water pressure booster system conforming to Section 606.5 shall be
installed on the building water supply system.
